title: An absent `Host` is a `400`; matching strips the port, folds ASCII case and one trailing dot, refuses non-ASCII, and an unknown host on a host-mounted deployment is a `404`
divergesFromPhp: there is no `ALLOWED_HOSTS`-style allowlist and no `$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']`: the host mounts are the allowlist, and nginx must send `proxy_set_header Host $host`
